exposure: Changes in perinatal care practices between two periods (2002-2006 vs 2007-2011)
cohort: The study included all live newborn infants of 22-26 weeks' gestational age born in or transferred to referral centers of the SEN1500 network in Spain within the first 28 days of life.
finding: During the second period (2007-2011), there was a greater adherence to beneficial perinatal practices, which was associated with increased survival and survival without major morbidity.
mod_finding: An increase in delivery by C-section was noted in the second period, which was one of the changes in perinatal care associated with improved outcomes.
